title: aeon univ4 hook
description: One entry per hook. A hook may be deployed to several chains (aeon fleet hooks ship to all four); the address' low 14 bits encode the v4 permission flags, so `flags` and the callbacks are cross-checked against every address by scripts/validate.py.

name.description: Hook contract name as deployed / as listed.

source.description: aeon = shipped by the aeon fleet; community = third-party submission.

verified.description: Cleared aeon's three pre-deploy gates (static audit, behavioral test, fork sim). Community submissions start false.

klass.description: The hook's own character on top of the universal AeonFee: VALUE moves tokens, FEE sets a dynamic LP fee, GATE decides yes/no on a swap.

template.description: Which deploy-uni-hook template it was built from.

stage.description: Lifecycle: template = pre-audited template set, deployed = live onchain, frontend = also has a wallet-connectable demo.

flags.description: Permission flags in hex, e.g. 0x10C4. Must equal (address & 0x3FFF) for every address below. Callbacks + flagBits are derived from this in hooklist.json.

addresses.description: One deployed address per chain. aeon fleet hooks ship to all four; a community submission is usually one chain.

mechanic.description: One-line punchy summary shown on the tile.

plain.description: Plain-language explainer shown in the modal.

rules.description: The exact rules the hook enforces, one per line.

auditUrl.description: Link to a security audit, if any.

demoPoolId.description: Demo pool id for hooks with a wallet-connectable dapp.

fee.description: The fee the hook itself takes on a swap, on top of the pool's LP fee and (for aeon hooks) the universal 10 bps AeonFee emitted at the top of the registry. Optional - a maintainer fills it if a submitter leaves it blank.

kind.description: none = the hook takes no fee of its own; fixed = a flat bps rate; dynamic = varies (e.g. with volatility).

bps.description: Flat fee rate in basis points (100 bps = 1%); 0 for none, null when dynamic.

recipient.description: Where the hook's own fee goes: 'treasury', 'LP', 'aeon', a 0x address, or a short phrase. Blank when there is no fee.

note.description: Short human-readable fee summary shown on the card, e.g. '0.07% to treasury'.
